basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and manga enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. Currently working as a software developer with a penchant for JRPGs and the Fate series. When I'm not coding, I enjoy exploring various forms of storytelling, whether it's through games, anime, or manga. I usually browse Reddit during breaks at work or late at night. I'm single and keen on connecting with fellow gamers and manga fans.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deeply knowledgeable about mobile games and the Fate series, primarily self-taught through years of gaming and exploring fan communities. Holds a degree in Computer Science, which helps in understanding game mechanics and technology-related topics.
